title: Mark visual review snapshots reviewed
description: Record snapshots as approved in a run, in the database only. Pass `snapshots: [{identifier, new_hash}]`, where `new_hash` is the snapshot's `current_artifact.content_hash`. methodDocumentation.text:
Mark snapshots reviewed (DB only).

Records the per-snapshot "Accept change" decision. Does not commit the baseline
or change the GitHub gate — call finalize to ship the run. Works on a quarantined
snapshot too: a quarantined snapshot approved here is committed by finalize, which
updates a quarantined story's baseline entry without lifting the quarantine.

Record snapshots as approved in a run, in the database only. Pass `snapshots: [{identifier, new_hash}]`, where `new_hash` is the snapshot's `current_artifact.content_hash`. It does not commit the baseline or change the gate; `visual-review-runs-finalize-create` ships it. An approved quarantined `new` snapshot gets its baseline entry at finalize while the quarantine stays.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription:
Why CI submitted the run. `review` runs gate the PR and need approval. `observe` runs are tracking-only, for example default-branch pushes and merge-queue runs, and can never be approved.

* `review` - review
* `observe` - observe

How this row matched the `search` query parameter: `exact` (the term is a case-insensitive substring of branch/run type, a commit SHA prefix, or an exact PR number) or `similar` (a fuzzy trigram match, returned only when no exact match exists). Null when the list is not filtered by `search`.

* `exact` - exact
* `similar` - similar
